findings.title: getSubGroupsCount can now return null, breaking primitive callers
findings.body: getSubGroupsCount() previously always delegated to a non-null model via getGroupModel(); now when modelSupplier.get() returns null (group deleted concurrently), the method returns null instead of throwing. GroupModel.getSubGroupsCount() is declared to return Long, but any caller treating this as always non-null (e.g. unboxing to long, or GroupUtils.populateSubGroupCount which calls representation.setSubGroupCount(group.getSubGroupsCount())) may now NPE downstream or silently store a null subgroup count where previously an exception made the failure obvious. This changes the contract silently without updating callers/docs.

findings.title: New concurrency test can leave a stray background thread and swallow failures
findings.body: The new test starts a raw Thread that loops until deletedAll is set, but there is no join() after `deletedAll.set(true)`, so the test may finish and assert before the thread observes the flag and before any trailing exception is recorded; the thread could also still be running when the test process exits. The lack of join() makes the assertion on caughtExceptions racy and the test potentially flaky or not actually exercising the fixed race before assertions run.
